description_md: Relative geostrophic velocity between adjacent CTD stations of each CalCOFI line, per cruise: dynamic height anomaly relative to 500 dbar (`gsw_geo_strf_dyn_height`), `v = (dh2 - dh1) / (f dx)`, averaged to 10 dbar bins. Positive is equatorward. Relative flow, so it has no climatology and no anomaly. `calcofi4db::ctd_geostrophic()`; CalCOFI/workflows#103.
Nearshore station of the pair, `LLL.L SSS.S`
Offshore station of the pair, `LLL.L SSS.S`
Along-line distance of the pair midpoint from the first station used, nearshore = 0
Great-circle distance between the two stations
Top of the 10 dbar bin (0 = surface bin)
Bin-mean velocity relative to 500 dbar; positive equatorward (90 degrees left of the offshore direction on a line running west-south-west)
TRUE when a cast of the pair is shallower than 500 dbar, so its deepest density is carried down (questions.csv Q03)
